evidence.title: antfarm readme
evidence.locator: Install; How it works; Dashboard; Commands; Requirements
evidence.finding: Documents a Node22 CLI using an existing host OpenClaw installation, YAML workflows, SQLite run state, cron polling, browser dashboard and gh PR steps.

evidence.title: antfarm src/installer/agent-cron.ts
evidence.locator: buildPollingPrompt lines128-157; setupAgentCrons lines160-195; active-run cron lifecycle lines203-249
evidence.finding: The polling agent claims a step and calls sessions_spawn with the assigned agentId and model. Product setup registers enabled OpenClaw every-interval agentTurn cron jobs; concurrent active runs keep the workflow crons alive.

evidence.title: antfarm src/installer/gateway-api.ts
evidence.finding: Uses the local OpenClaw gateway on127.0.0.1 with configured token or password in a Bearer header, and falls back to the openclaw cron CLI. This is control-plane authentication, not evidence of a coding-agent subscription.

evidence.title: antfarm workflows/feature-dev/workflow.yml
evidence.locator: agents; plan; setup lines116-145; implement loop; pr lines301-329; review lines331-389
evidence.finding: Feature workflow defines planner, setup, developer, verifier, tester and reviewer roles, creates a Git branch in the supplied repo, persists story/result handoffs and instructs gh PR creation and review. It is a workflow instruction contract, not tested enforcement.

evidence.title: antfarm src/installer/run.ts
evidence.locator: startWorkflow function: INSERT INTO runs and steps; initial status running/pending
evidence.finding: Starting a workflow creates durable run and step records and enables its agent polling jobs.

evidence.finding: The Antfarm source is under the MIT license.
